claim: Try it with sample data opens a realistic, resettable sample that is separate from the real board.
sandbox: Fresh browser context: add a real bill, enter /demo, modify and reset the sample, then return to the untouched real board.

claim: Records supplier, reference, amount, currency, and a local-calendar due date.
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context: add a bill and assert its displayed supplier, reference, currency amount, and formatted due date.

claim: Keeps a PDF or image attachment in browser storage.
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context: attach a PDF, reload, and download the same named attachment.

claim: Shows due totals and supports search, filters, and sorting.
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context: use the seeded mixed-status sample to assert summary labels, search, paid filter, and amount sort.

claim: Records a paid date and payment note, and can reopen a bill.
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context: record a paid date/note and reopen the same bill.

claim: Prepares a weekly supplier review of overdue, due-soon, and recently paid bills.
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context: prepare the print sheet and assert its title and seeded attention/paid bills.

claim: Exports JSON and CSV, imports a backup, and deletes local data.
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context: download JSON and CSV, delete the sample, then import the JSON backup.

claim: Rejects an invalid backup without changing current bills.
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context: import a structurally invalid backup and assert seeded bills remain.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Dedicated new browser context: visit populated /demo under service-worker control, go offline, reload, and assert the board remains.

claim: Stores the board in this browser, uses no account, and makes no tracking requests.
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context: complete and reload a bill flow while recording requests and cookies; assert the bill remains, only same-origin requests occur, and no cookies exist.

claim: Does not connect to a bank or send a payment; a paid status is a manual record.
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context: record a paid status while recording requests; assert a local paid status and only same-origin requests.
Fresh browser context: enter the sample from the landing page and add a bill without an account or payment step.
